target_customer: Compliance and BSA teams at banks, scaled fintechs, new programs and credit unions
problem: Compliance teams drown in backlogs of complaints, audits, testing and data requests. Hickory agents do the document gathering and analysis and leave decisions to humans.
business_model: B2B SaaS with three products: Analyst Studio, Automated Workflows and a Tailored Knowledge Base
product_category: Agentic compliance and BSA software for financial institutions

founders.name: Joshua Howland
previous_startups: Seis (YC W22), online banking for Spanish speakers in the US
founders.background_notes: YC page says his team built enterprise software for banks including Bank of America and Capital One and that Seis passed $10M revenue in 15 months.

competitors.name: Hadrius
competitors.what: Agentic compliance infrastructure for financial services

competitors.name: Hummingbird
competitors.what: Orchestration platform where AI agents and analysts handle AML triage and SAR filing
competitors.traction_then: Customers named on its site include Raymond James and Crypto.com

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs grounded citations, audit trails, SOC 2 and single-tenant hosting for banks, but built on available LLMs. Founder's bank engineering background helps.

defensibility.rationale: Bank trust, integration and a curated BSA knowledge base help, yet several funded rivals sell the same agentic compliance pitch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown so far; rivals raised large rounds in 2026 per fintech trade press.

market_need_then: 2026 coverage describes a wave of agentic compliance funding and a view that the old compliance stack will not survive. Hickory says its customers' teams get 10x more done, an unverified claim.

identity.visual_style: Navy and green, patterned graphics (inferred by the fetch tool, not stated)
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct imperative headlines with playful words like Superpowers

brand_strength.rationale: Early B2B brand; search results about the name returned furniture companies in Hickory, North Carolina and a defunct software startup.

outcome_analysis: Hickory is an active Fall 2026 YC company with a repeat founder who ran bank compliance and previously co-founded Seis. No outcome exists yet. Founder market fit is strong, but funded rivals sell similar agentic BSA tools and traction is not public.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom shows $125K, single aggregator, so no round recorded. Founder education not found. Greenlite AI (AML agents, $15M Series A) was omitted from competitors because its source had no date. No shutdown or acquisition found for Hickory or Seis in search (results were unrelated Hickory businesses).
